subject: Game maker Ubisoft founder killed in France plane crash
posts:
A tragic end for a pioneer of the gaming industry. Claude Guillemot, co-founder of Ubisoft, dies in a plane crash.
Evidence: Tragic accident, Industry loss, Public record.
#Ubisoft #Gaming

Reports confirm that Claude Guillemot, a co-founder of Ubisoft, died in a Cessna crash in western France while attempting to land at La Baule Airport.
